name: ack
prompt: A single short soft UI bubble pop, gentle rounded click confirming a small action.

name: invalid
prompt: A dull muted error thunk, low wooden knock with a short soft buzz, clearly negative but not harsh.

name: feed
prompt: Cartoon munching: two or three happy crunchy bites on crisp food, cute creature eating.

name: wash
prompt: Water splashing in a small tub with bubbly scrubbing and a quick rinsing trickle.

name: play
prompt: A rubber ball boing, springy cartoon bounce with a bright playful wobble.

name: rest
prompt: A soft sleepy yawn and slow relaxed exhale, cozy bedding rustle, winding down to sleep.

name: pet
prompt: A short warm cat purr trill, soft contented vibrating rumble rising slightly at the end.

name: sing
prompt: Three cheerful rising notes whistled by a small bird-like creature, bright and melodic.

name: toss
prompt: A quick airy whoosh of a light soft toy thrown through the air, ending with a faint flump.

name: snack
prompt: One quick delighted nom bite, small crisp crunch with a tiny lip smack.

name: decorate
prompt: A small wooden object being placed on a table, soft clunk followed by a tiny pleasant chime.

name: craving
prompt: A cute small creature squeak rising in pitch like a question, hopeful and pleading.

name: craving-met
prompt: A bright happy two-note chime, sparkling wish-granted ding with a light shimmer.

name: discovery
prompt: A sparkling three-note glockenspiel reveal, magical twinkle ascending with soft shimmer tail.

name: bond-up
prompt: A warm ascending four-note harp fanfare, gentle celebratory glow, heartfelt and cozy.

name: complete
prompt: A cheerful five-note ascending victory jingle on bells and mallets, bright satisfying finish.

name: expired
prompt: A soft descending three-note sad trombone-like tone, gentle time-is-up letdown, not harsh.

name: neglected
prompt: A low worried creature whimper motif in three descending notes, lonely and pleading.

name: ui-open
prompt: A very short soft interface click pop with a slight rising pitch, panel opening.

name: ui-close
prompt: A very short soft interface click pop with a slight falling pitch, panel closing.
